name: bible-on-site-recitation-decoder
description: Offline recitation decoder build inputs owned by the native app. The decoder versions must stay identical to the website's runtime dependencies in web/bible-on-site/package.json (mpg123-decoder, ogg-opus-decoder); check-decoder-pins.mjs enforces the alignment. See web/bible-on-site/src/lib/recitation-audio.ts for the browser counterpart.
